description: a young woman seer with long wavy golden blond hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, a silver blindfold band over her eyes and a silver circlet, a long dark blue robe sprinkled with small silver stars and silver patterns at the hem, a golden eye symbol on the chest, a grey belt with brown leather pouches, a long dark blue starry cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, a calm young woman's face in clean profile, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and the eyes covered by the blindfold, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
